notes.title: Appeal to the community
notes.notes: Family, we want to make you happy. All these 4 months we are working on the game, because we want to translate into the game, what we promised. We have small financial problems, this section has been developed for another 4 months. Above we mentioned that we will be in early access until 2019, but we will try to release the game earlier. We do not please you with updates, because we do not want to open all the cards, but we will release a full-fledged game. We made a 50% discount, and now the game costs $ 3.

notes.title: How to play?
notes.notes:
In order to play, it's enough to press "play" in the game menu.
And wait until you connect to the server.
If the game is not found.
You create it, and another player will connect to you.
Good luck!
Before playing, learn the rules!
